# `bow` content schema

<!-- Generated by pnpm content:docs from the "bow" schema in src/content/registry.ts; do not edit. -->

One JSON file per entry in `src/content/data/bow/`. Fields marked "required" must be present;
every other field takes the default shown when omitted ("—" = stays absent).

| Field | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `id` | id | required | Unique bow id, e.g. "shortbow". |
| `name` | string | required | Player-facing name. |
| `notes` | string | required | What the bow is for, and where its numbers come from. |
| `fullDrawTicks` | integer > 0 ≤ 3600 | required | Sim ticks (60 Hz) of holding fire to reach full draw (48 = 800 ms). |
| `minDrawTicks` | integer 0–3600 | required | A release before this many ticks of draw cancels the shot and returns the arrow; ≤ fullDrawTicks. |
| `maxLaunchSpeed` | number > 0 ≤ 200 | required | Launch speed at full draw, m/s. |
| `minLaunchFraction` | number 0–1 | required | Fraction of maxLaunchSpeed at zero draw, 0–1; the speed lerps linearly to 1 at full draw. |
| `drawStaminaCost` | number 0–100 | required | Stamina spent when a draw starts (never refunded). |
| `holdTicks` | integer 0–3600 | required | Ticks full draw may be held for free; past them stamina drains and at 0 the draw collapses. |
| `holdDrainPerSecond` | number 0–100 | required | Stamina drained per second while full draw is held past holdTicks. |
| `walkScale` | number 0–1 | required | Movement speed while drawn, as a fraction of the run speed (0–1); no sprint. |
| `aim` | object | required | Presentation: the over-shoulder aim view while drawn (src/game/camera). |
| `aim.fov` | number 20–120 | required | Camera vertical field of view at full draw, degrees (the camera’s is 70). |
| `aim.time` | number > 0 ≤ 2 | required | Seconds for the field of view to ease about two thirds of the way in (and back out). |
